v.1: What is it that they are questioning each other about?!
v.3: the one about which they differ?
v.4: No indeed! Soon they will know!
v.5: No indeed! Soon they will know for once again!
v.6: Did We not make the earth a resting place?
v.9: and make your sleep for rest?
v.10: and make the night a covering?
v.11: and make the day for livelihood?
v.12: and build above you the seven mighty heavens?
v.13: and make [the sun for] a radiant lamp?
v.14: and send down water pouring from the rain-clouds,
v.15: that We may bring forth with it grains and plants,
v.17: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst,
v.18: the day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will come in groups,
v.19: and the sky will be opened and become gates,
v.20: and the mountains will be set moving and become a mirage.
v.24: tasting in it neither any coolness nor drink,
v.27: Indeed they did not expect any reckoning,
v.28: and they denied Our signs mendaciously,
v.29: and We have figured everything in a Book.
v.30: So [now] taste! We shall increase you in nothing but punishment!
v.31: Indeed a triumph awaits the Godwary:
v.33: and buxom maidens of a like age,
v.35: Therein they shall hear neither vain talk nor lies
v.36: —a reward and a sufficing bounty from your Lord,
v.37: the All-beneficent, the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them. They will not be able to address Him
v.38: on the day when the Spirit and the angels stand in an array: none shall speak except someone who is permitted by the All-beneficent and says what is rightful.
v.39: That day is true for certain. So let anyone who wishes take resort with his Lord.
v.40: Indeed We have warned you of a punishment near at hand—the day when a person will observe what his hands have sent ahead and the faithless one will say, ‘I wish I were dust!’
